race.comment: DIVINE FIRE (5) put it all together to score a well deserved victory on the back of some solid efforts, getting the job done by a head here last time as public elect. Milnes sticks and can make it two on the trot. SUIT OF WANDS (8) got things back on track last time at Murray Bridge when battling on gamely into the placings. Is already winner over this track and trip and boasts the peaks to take this out. RETOURNE (14) doesn't win out of turn but only just missed here last time behind DIVINE FIRE, who he meets a kilo better this time  Can turn the tables. I LOVE THIS SONG (12) will likely find himself a long way off the speed again from the car park draw but if the early pace is strong he could cause a late scare.
